exposure.note: openvibe.locker serves Drive, Sends and the recovery kit once Locker's vhost replaces the parked 302 to openvibe.download (Network #678, the same step).

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP

drains: uploads in flight finish or keep their resumable parts
the cleanup timer stops after its batch
HTTP server closed and in-flight requests drained
PostgreSQL pool closed, then the process exits

resumes.what: items, Sends, reservations and upload sessions in ov_locker survive a stop; ciphertext lives in Media's locker tenant
the cleanup is due-based: its first run after a stop expires Sends, releases abandoned uploads and retries Media erasure

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migrations are expand only; an earlier release reads none of what a later one added

leases.none: Locker holds no cross-service leases; quota reservations are rows in its own database.

site.name: Locker
site.what: End-to-end encrypted files and expiring Sends: OpenVibe stores only ciphertext and cannot read what is inside.
